story_text: As a staff member, I want to filter bookings by an invalid status to return an error so that only valid filter values are accepted.

positive.title: Filter bookings by a completely invalid status string
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with query parameter status=INVALID_STATUS
2. Check the response status code and message
positive.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · message lists accepted status values

positive.title: Filter bookings by each valid status value
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with query parameter status=CONFIRMED
2. Check the response status code and message
positive.expected_result: 200 OK · results contain only bookings matching that status

negative.title: Filter with numeric status value
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with query parameter status=123
2. Check the response status code and message
negative.expected_result: 400 Bad Request · numeric values not accepted as status

negative.title: Filter as unauthenticated user
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with unauthenticated user
2. Check the response status code and message

edge.title: Filter with status value in wrong case (e.g. confirmed instead of CONFIRMED)
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with query parameter status=confirmed
2. Check the response status code and message

edge.title: Filter with empty status value
steps: 1. Send GET request to /bookings with query parameter status=
2. Check the response status code and message
edge.expected_result: 200 OK with all bookings related to the user are displayed
